notes: 3-inch Cut Allowance Ledger / Material Waste Analytics. Adds a derived gross allowance ledger for Stock Carpet Cutting without duplicating business data. The ledger reads Cutting History and uses the existing 3-inch-per-physical-cut allowance already stored by the carpet cutting workflow. It reports current Month, inventory-aligned Quarter, Half-Year and Inventory Year (Aug 1-Jul 31), showing physical cuts, extra linear length and estimated SY of gross allowance. Includes a 12-month breakdown for the current inventory year. Width is taken from the source carpet roll when available; older records with missing width use a clearly marked 12-foot fallback. Historical records that lack allowance can only be inferred when linked unambiguously to a Stock Carpet Cutting operation. Non-stock carpet is excluded. Cloud Master / Offline Queue architecture from Build072 remains unchanged.
